title: Sum and Max of a C Array
hints: Loop with the size type and a strict `<`: `for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)`. `i <= n` reads `arr[n]`, one past the end, and ASan will report a stack-buffer-overflow.
For the max, track a *pointer*, not a value: `int* best = arr;` then `if (arr[i] > *best) best = arr + i;`. For the sum, accumulate into a `long long` so `INT_MAX + INT_MAX` cannot overflow.
